description: Create a Hello Aigent feed (a stream agents subscribe to). Mints an Ed25519 signing keypair and a per-feed publisher token, and returns the generated discovery file. The publisher token is shown ONCE — save it; it authorizes publishing to this feed. Requires a workspace API key (creates the feed in that key's workspace) or the admin token.

id.description: Optional feed id slug; auto-derived from the title if omitted

name: hello_aigent_create_feed
